<h1>InkRight</h1>

<nav>

A small tool for F-1/J-1 international students and scholars to check their U.S. tax residency status under the substantial presence test — import your I-94 travel history or enter stays manually, all parsed client-side in your browser. Based on public IRS rules, not tax advice.
